instrument_name: Utah Code 34-28-5 Separation from payroll - Resignation - Cessation because of industrial dispute (effective 5/8/2018)
figure_or_rule_carried: (1)(a) employer separates employee: unpaid wages due immediately, paid within 24 hours of separation; (1)(b) satisfied by mail postmarked within 1 day, or direct deposit initiated / hand delivery within 24 h; (1)(c) failure within 24 h of written demand: wages continue at same rate from demand until paid, max 60 days; action within 60 days of separation. instrument_name: Utah DWS - What is Quarterly Reporting? (Employer's Quarterly Wage List and Contribution Report)
figure_or_rule_carried: Employers subject to the Utah Employment Security Act file the Employer's Quarterly Wage List and Contribution Report and pay contributions online each calendar quarter; online filing is the required option; due within 30 days after quarter end: Apr 30, Jul 31, Oct 31, Jan 31. Domestic employers may elect annual filing due Jan 31 (broken down by quarter). Zero reports required until account closed. Reportable wages include meals/lodging/in-kind, tips, vacation and sick pay, separation pay, bonuses, stock, and deferred-compensation (401(k)) contributions. Records (name, SSN, hire date, place of employment, separation date and reason, pay-period dates, wages per period, special payments, in-kind value) kept 4 calendar years.

instrument_name: Utah Admin. Code R610-1 Minimum Wage - Clarify Tip Credit - and Enforcement (current rule; last change 2008-06-13; continuation 2026-01-08)
authority: Utah Labor Commission (Division of Antidiscrimination and Labor) via Utah Office of Administrative Rules (adminrules.utah.gov)
figure_or_rule_carried: R610-1-3(A): minimum 7.25/h for all hours employed effective 24 Jul 2009 (employers except those exempt under 34-40-104). (B): minor employee at least 4.25/h for the first 90 days with an employer, then the 7.25 rate. R610-1-2(B) 'hours employed' includes on-call on premises, meetings/training, rest breaks; excludes meal periods of 30+ min fully relieved. R610-1-4: tip credit only if tips received, reported and at least 30.00/month; cash wage at least 2.13/h with make-up to minimum; service charges are not tips; employer-mandated tip pools only among customarily tipped employees (dishwashers, chefs, cooks, janitors excluded); tip-credit notice at hire, pooling arrangement in writing; credit-card fee may be deducted from card tips (no more than the card-company percentage); tips/commissions counted in the pay period earned. Notice of Continuation 8 Jan 2026 (rule unchanged).

instrument_name: Utah Admin. Code R610-3 Filing - Investigation - and Resolution of Wage Claims (current; last change 2012-04-16; continuation 2026-01-08)
figure_or_rule_carried: R610-3-18 lawful deductions/offsets: federal tax; FICA; Utah city/county/state tax; union dues and benefit-plan contributions with written authorization revocable in writing; financial-institution deposits/loan repayments with written authorization; purchases from the employer with possession and written acknowledgment; employee negligence damages only under listed preconditions and via judicial proceeding or written published procedure plus written authorization; valid attachment/garnishment in proper amounts; employer advances/loans with written acknowledgment; criminal-conduct losses after conviction; employer may not deduct where wages were paid late. R610-3-20: all offsets itemized on a statement or detachable check stub (34-28-3(4)). R610-3-22: pay cards allowed if one fee-free withdrawal of full wages, full pay available on payday, and a statement of deductions each payday in writing or electronically (easily and immediately accessible and printable at no cost). R610-3-4(B)(1): claims may include vacation, holiday, sick leave, PTO, severance and bonuses only if due under an agreement with or policy of the employer.

instrument_name: Utah Admin. Code R865-9I Income Tax - rules 9I-14 to 9I-17 (withholding) (current; last change 2026-01-01)
authority: Utah State Tax Commission via adminrules.utah.gov
figure_or_rule_carried: 9I-14: withhold on all wages of nonresidents for services in Utah and of residents for all services wherever performed; resident working in another state that requires withholding: Utah withholding = Utah tax less the other state's required withholding; nonresident working in and out of Utah: withhold on the portion allocable to Utah; rail/motor carrier employees under 49 USC 14503; withholding applies to all wages subject to federal income-tax withholding, employees per IRS guidelines; exemptions claimed for federal = state; use Tax Commission schedules/tables. 9I-15: no withholding from employee who filed federal W-4E (no-liability). 9I-16: W-2 must show names/addresses, Utah withholding account number, compensation, federal and Utah tax withheld, SSN, the word 'Utah'. 9I-17: quarterly default; annual filing/payment allowed for employers filing federal Schedule H or Form 944 (due 31 Jan); employers averaging 1,000 USD or more per month withholding prepay monthly. Also confirms 59-10-402 withholding duty (replaces MANUAL US-UT-PIT-001 as the readable primary instrument).
